speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Osgood-Schlatter disease. Given the patient's age (7 years old is slightly young but possible), the classic presentation of pain at the tibial tuberosity exacerbated by activity, and the absence of fever or trauma, the clinical picture strongly points to this common overuse injury of the tibial tubercle apophysis. No further tests are needed at this time.
